# Certificate

## Summary
Proof of completion under an authority: number, snapshots (name, course, cohort, credit, letter), issued/revoked status, derived verification code. A record — snapshots are intentional.

## Usage
Created by Issue Certificate; mounts Certificate View.

## Non-goals
Never deleted; revocation keeps the number.
